long_biography.plain_text:
Music became one of Sultan Qaboos's most distinctive forms of cultural institution-building. A committed patron, he founded the Royal Oman Symphony Orchestra as a professional ensemble of Omani musicians and later established the Royal Opera House Muscat. The opera house brought international opera, ballet and orchestral performance into a national cultural programme.

Environmental protection formed a second durable commitment. Qaboos established government bodies, laws and nature reserves for conservation, and his international prize through UNESCO recognised work protecting the environment. These institutions outlasted his reign and placed both culture and conservation within the public architecture of modern Oman.
